title: Episode About the Sacrifice of Elder Sahibzadas

blocks.text: The Guru placed his kalgi and garments on Sant Singh and, in the pattern of succession remembered from Guru Nanak to Guru Angad, marked the Khalsa to carry sovereignty onward. (9–10)

He then arranged the exhausted defenders for the night: Jiwan Singh was stationed in the upper position, the remaining Singhs were spread across the fort, and trusted Pathans were drawn into the plan for escape. (11–15)

A hidden opening was made ready, the Guru armed himself lightly with a dagger and a few coins, and a diversion was prepared so that he could move out while the enemy was thrown into confusion. (16–17)
